correctness.rationale: For r,c in F_(3^n)^×, the transformed sextic has branch equation (t³−t)²=−1/r. The additive map t↦t³−t has image trace-zero, so rational β gives two split cubics (trace zero) or two irreducible cubics (trace nonzero). Nonsquare β gives Frobenius conjugation ±β and trace zero over the quadratic extension, hence 2³ cycles. Frobenius-fixed unordered Weierstrass pairs give rational 2-torsion orders 16,4,1. Pairs ±β parametrize (q−3)/6, nonsquares (q−1)/2, and remainder q/3. Sextic derivative vanishes only at 0,±1, where sextic is nonzero, establishing smooth genus two. Boundary q=3 has empty fully split class. Finite-field source checker uses polynomial gcd of f with T^(q^d)−T in q=3,9,27,81; uniform proof is algebraic, not 116 tests.
